[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Fender Mustang LT25 is an excellent practice amp.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The street price for the Mustang LT25 is usually around $200-$250.

[USER] User asks if the Fender Mustang LT25 would be suitable for their kid brother who is just starting to play the drums.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Fender Mustang LT25 is a guitar amplifier and not suitable for drums.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A drum amplifier is needed for a drummer to handle low-end frequencies and dynamic range.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A good drum amp should have a power output of around 20-50 watts, a frequency response of 50 Hz to 15 kHz, multiple channels, and a durable design.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Yamaha EAD10 (a drum amp designed for electronic drums).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Behringer XD80 (a budget-friendly drum amp).
